entries.title: SSD1677 differential wipe intermediate state not visible
entries.reproduction_scope: Controller-level activation/BUSY/commit semantics are modeled; analog intermediate gray/ghost appearance is not truthfully reproducible without physical calibration.
entries.physical_limitations: Electrophoretic particle response and multi-phase analog gray progression require a real GDEQ0426T82/SSD1677 panel trace.

entries.title: Internal RAM fragmentation causes TLS/list/chapter OOM while PSRAM is free
entries.reproduction_scope: Independent internal banks fragment below a 48KiB contiguous TLS peak while total/PSRAM free remain high; wrong framebuffer placement is separately rejected.
entries.physical_limitations: Exact Arduino/mbedTLS allocation sizes remain version-specific and must be calibrated from device traces.

entries.title: JJWXC reader internal-RAM peak: keep-alive versus fresh TLS prefetch
entries.reproduction_scope: The two constituent mechanisms are automated: persistent TLS consumes internal residency, while a new handshake requires a larger contiguous peak; chapter lifecycle is tested separately.
entries.physical_limitations: Exact combined occupancy of Wi-Fi, WebServer, font caches and task stacks needs an imported device heap trace.

entries.title: Cross-chapter empty-path/reopen chain and repeated-generation instability
entries.reproduction_scope: The simulator rejects empty/partial paths, requires old reader generation teardown before download/open, runs 79 consecutive handoffs and enforces a transition watchdog budget.
entries.physical_limitations: The exact historical WDT backtrace still depends on real firmware scheduling/SD latency and belongs to QEMU/device validation.

entries.title: Native WeRead HTTPS body-read panic with PSRAM worker/control objects
entries.reproduction_scope: Memory contracts now reject PSRAM placement of TLS worker stack and HTTP/WiFiClientSecure control objects while requiring large body/decode payloads in PSRAM.
evidence: panic stack mbedtls_ssl_read -> NetworkClientSecure -> HTTPClient -> M4NativeProviderHttp
entries.physical_limitations: A true reproduction of the mbedTLS/lwIP panic requires executing the affected Arduino-ESP32 binary in QEMU or on device; the host model only proves residency contracts.

entries.title: Native UI tile truncation / confirm / JJWXC catalog-empty device regression
entries.reproduction_scope: Application/UI behavior is covered in m4-firmware native host regressions rather than duplicated in the hardware simulator.
entries.physical_limitations: Pixel parity still benefits from real renderer/QEMU framebuffer screenshots.

entries.title: Runtime UI TTF physical pixel size ignored uiScale
entries.reproduction_scope: Closed upstream after the runtime-TTF physical-pixel fix; keep it in the historical acceptance matrix because preview/device parity is a recurring class.
evidence: device UI_10 measured about 31px under uiScale=82
entries.physical_limitations: Final glyph raster appearance remains renderer/font dependent.

entries.title: Catalog/chapter SD write failure and transient HTTP connection failure
entries.reproduction_scope: SD publication reproduces rename failure, bounded 2KiB copy fallback, write failure, sync/size verification policy and preservation of the previous generation. HTTP zero-byte retry policy remains in firmware integration tests.
entries.physical_limitations: Card-specific FAT/exFAT controller behavior and RF/Wi-Fi reconnect timing require device/QEMU integration.

entries.title: Variable TTF load failure and system UI missing glyphs
entries.reproduction_scope: m4-firmware PR #25 added variable-glyf default-instance parsing and exact cmap UI coverage regression tests.
evidence: field '字体加载失败，保持原字体'
entries.physical_limitations: Font rendering performance and visual raster quality remain device/render calibration concerns.

entries.reproduction_scope: No exact event/state trace is currently available, so this is deliberately not marked reproduced.
